data.one_liner: A faithful Flutter implementation of the Material 3 Expressive component set.
data.what_it_does: Provides 44 M3E widget components across Actions, Selection, Containment, Navigation, and Feedback with spring physics and shape morphing. Exposes design tokens and themes through M3ETheme and M3EMaterialApp.
use_when: You want to build an app using the Material 3 Expressive component set and guidelines
You need ready-to-use widgets with spring-driven press feedback, shape morphing, and state layers
avoid_when: You must use standard package:flutter/material.dart directly without importing material_ui
You require a non-Material custom design system or Cupertino styling
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of 44 widgets across 39 component modules
Expressive motion and interaction with spring physics and per-destination selection indicators
Built-in support for dynamic color, seed colors, and custom typography scales
weaknesses: Requires switching from package:flutter/material.dart to package:material_ui/material_ui.dart
Potential name clashes for RoundedPolygon and CornerRounding requiring import hiding
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart along with material_ui instead of standard material.dart.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Material components rather than the Material 3 Expressive set.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want iOS-style Cupertino components instead of Material Design.
